title: Deep Pitch Estimator
text: Estimate pitch with CREPE deep learning neural network, 1 input, 1 output, no direct feedthrough, {Model capacity} sets Size of trained neural network; {Sample rate of input signal (Hz)} sets the sample rate of input signal, {Overlap percentage (%)} sets the overlap percentage between consecutive, {Number of buffered pitch estimations} sets the number of pitch estimations in output and {Confidence threshold} sets the pitch confidence threshold. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Sample rate of input signal (Hz)
params.values: Sample rate of input signal in Hz 16e3 (default) | positive scalar

params.name: Number of buffered pitch estimations
params.values: Number of pitch estimations in output 1 (default) | positive integer

params.name: Confidence threshold
params.values: Pitch confidence threshold 0.5 (default) | scalar in the range [0, 1)

params.name: Model capacity
params.values: Size of trained neural network Full (default) | Large | Medium | Small | Tiny
